text:
mika: starting staged rollout v2.14.0 -> starting at 5% in eu-west (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). pin v2.13 as immediate fallback. release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v2.14.0 :megaphone:

dev-deploy-bot: deploy started: canary=5% region=eu-west rollout_id=rl-1798765432
```
deploybot: create_rollout --id rl-1798765432 --version v2.14.0 --region eu-west --percent 5
pods: pool-ev1-{3}
status: IN_PROGRESS
```

rachel: quick heads-up — observability spike on 95p token latency +120ms on 3/6 pods since rollout start. not huge but visible. dashboard: https://observability/reports/rl-1798765432

sam: thanks. what's the target threshold for auto-hold? we set auto-hold=10% for latency+p95 > +100ms last 5m?

mika: correct. auto-hold is 10% for this release. asking ops: go/no-go to ramp to 20% manually now or hold at 5% for investigation? @ops @rachel

ops: vote=HOLD. want to check KVCACHE and tail latencies. :warning:

rachel: looking into pod logs. small GC bursts on two pods correlated with traffic shift. digging.

mika: ok pausing manual ramp. decision: PAUSE at 5% and schedule quick rollback plan if 10m doesn't improve. tagging product for impact: @li

li: noted. can we add a feature-flag rollback path? prefer soft-pin to v2.13 for EU while we investigate.

dev-deploy-bot: rollout rl-1798765432 PAUSED by policy (reason: latency spike). pinned fallback v2.13 on region eu-west.

```
deploybot: pause_rollout --id rl-1798765432 --reason "p95 latency > +100ms"
deploybot: pin_fallback --region eu-west --version v2.13
```

sam: created incident checklist ticket INF-4821 and started a short RCA. link: https://issues/INF-4821

mika: thanks. action items: (1) ops/rachel rootcause + fix (2) if no improvement in 10m -> rollback to v2.13 (3) update release notes w/hold + postmortem link. I'll update the release doc.

li: will update release notes and notify partners. will postpone 20% ramp until confirmed.

ops: will run memory/GC probe on affected hosts now. ping when done.

rachel: probe shows GC config mismatch on 2 pods; rolling config patch to test. will report back in 8-10m.

mika: solid. leaving thread open. :thumbsup:
